about_the_game:
The Clown's Forest 3: The Final Act is the final game in The Clown's Forest Trilogy. It acts as both a Prequel and Sequel to the games that came before it. Told in two separate campaigns to show the end of the series and how David and Oliver died ten years previously.

STORY (THE FINAL ACT)

Michael and Ethan survived the terrible ordeal back in August, after saving Lucy and Jonathan they laid low for a bit, watching the news and checking to see when Blitzo will be active again. After a gruesome story caught their eye, they arrive back to Hartown Park for the last time, on the tenth anniversary of The Hartown Amusement Park Massacre.

Right off the bat, something is terribly wrong. Blitzo no longer looks the same, and he has become more aggressive and ruthless than ever before.

Can Michael and Ethan stop Blitzo one last time?

STORY (HAUNTING APPARITIONS)

On a cold snowy night on December 17th 2012... Jonathan Longhurst succumbed to the possession of Blitzo. Oliver and David are in danger as Blitzo targets them directly due to their connection with Jonathan Longhurst. Separated from each other, Oliver and David need to try and escape the clutches of the killer clown. Oliver has aid from his best friend, Alex Barlow; while David has no one to help him. Witness the events that transpired the series and find out how both of them died.

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

  • Puzzles - Puzzles return from the first two titles, but this time they are even more mind-bending and deadly. Use hints around the environment to proceed.

  • Highly Detailed Maps - The maps are more detailed than ever before, with exploration being encouraged!

  • Compelling Cast of Characters - Characters are written to be much more realistic than ever before!

  • No Holding Back - Blitzo has become ruthless in the four months that separated The Clown's Forest 2 and The Clown's Forest 3, and has become even more deadly than ever before. 

  • Chase Sequences - Chases are now even more thrilling with a dynamic camera system that zooms in and out depending on location.

  • Spine-Chilling Moments - Sinister sequences are made even more terrifying with atmospheric music to add to the tension.

content_descriptors.notes: This game features Pixel Art depicting flesh and blood. And also features detailed text-based death scenes.
